Objective: Grow your tribe to 7 villagers.

• Your Town Center supports only 4 villagers
• You must build 1 House (supports 4 more villagers)
• Houses cost 30 wood each
• Villagers cost 50 food each

Objectives: Collect food and then construct 3 buildings:

• Granary (120 wood)
• Storage Pit (120 wood)
• Dock (100 wood)

Objective: Find 5 Discoveries before the Libyans find them.

• Discoveries are in the shape of a white horse
• Walk through the Discovery to capture it
• Create multiple villagers to protect explorers

Objective: Advance to the Tool Age. To do this you must:

• Build a Town Center
• Construct two different Stone Age buildings

Objective: Destroy the invading tribe.

• Click units to reveal capabilities
• Idle soldiers automatically attack enemies within sight

Objectives: Control the Ruin and stockpile 800 food.

• A Market must be constructed before Farms can be built
• Research Technology to upgrade efficiency of Farms

Objectives: Stockpile 500 stone and 500 gold.

• Villagers deposit stone and gold at the Town Center
• Assign multiple villagers to mines to increase production
• Establish trade routes with foreign Docks using Trade Boats or Merchant Ships

Objectives: Capture (convert) the Stone Thrower and bring it to your Town Center.

• Use Priests to convert enemy units
• Research at the Temple for upgrades to Priests
• Mine gold to replace killed Priests

Objectives: Find the island and build on it.

• Locate the island on the Nile River
• Build a Town Center on the island
• Build two Sentry Towers on the island

Objectives: Recover the stolen Artifact and bring it back to your Town Center.

• Artifact colors indicate ownership
• Artifacts cannot be destroyed
• Artifacts can be moved on land or by vessel

Objective: Build a Wonder. To do this you must:

• Advance to the Iron Age
• Stockpile 1000 wood, 1000 stone, and 1000 gold
Objective: Destroy the Canaanite Government Center in the city of Megiddo.
